pages.text: $(l)Dark Matter$() and $(l)Red Matter$() are the mod's signature materials. Almost every advanced tool, weapon, armor piece and machine is built from them.$(br2)$(l)How to get them:$()$(br2)$(li)$(l)Dark Matter:$() 8 Aeternalis Fuel around 1 diamond block.$(li)$(l)Red Matter:$() 6 Aeternalis Fuel around 3 Dark Matter.$(li)$(l)Matter Blocks:$() craft 4 matter into a block, or break the block back into 4.

$(l)Matter Blocks$() are building blocks. They are extremely tough, glow with light, and can only be mined with a Dark or Red Matter tool of the right tier. They are the main ingredient of the $(l:matter/matter_furnaces)Matter Furnaces$(), the $(l:utilities/dm_pedestal)Dark Matter Pedestal$() and the late-game machines.$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()

$(li)Both matter items and blocks are fireproof, so they survive lava.$(li)Matter Blocks emit light, which makes them handy for marking your base.$(li)Matter is used both as a material and as fuel for the higher-tier crafting recipes for tools, armor and condensers.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() none specific.
